basic_info.description: This unit offers incredible convenience with no stairs from the street to your front door in this elevator building. Inside, you'll find a well-appointed 3BD, 2BA layout with remodeled kitchen & bathrooms, in-unit laundry & fireplace.  Step outside your unit and ascend to the huge common rooftop deck, where you'll be captivated by panoramic views of the San Francisco Bay, the Ferris wheel, the iconic Transamerica Building, and historic Coit Tower. This is the perfect spot for entertaining, relaxing, or simply soaking in the breathtaking San Francisco skyline. The condo also includes a deeded parking spot in a secure, gated garage, providing peace of mind and ultimate convenience in this bustling urban environment. Experience the quintessential San Francisco lifestyle a rare 3D, 2BA opportunity with near-perfect 99 Walk Score®. Everything you desire is just steps away! From your doorstep, immerse yourself in the charm of North Beach, the allure of Fisherman's Wharf, & the cultural richness of Chinatown. Enjoy a straight shot to the Financial District (FiDi), making your commute a breeze. The surrounding area boasts an incredible array of restaurants, cafes, & shops, offering endless dining & entertainment.
